parameters.name: authorized_categories
parameters.description: Enforced at settlement against the category the merchant signed onto each cart line; a line outside this list aborts with ₹0 charged. Use the merchant catalog's spellings (matched case-insensitively). Empty means no restriction.

parameters.name: buyer_agent_id
parameters.description: Required for agent_held; omitted otherwise. did:agent: plus 64 lowercase hex.

parameters.name: key_custody
parameters.description: No default. State which party holds the buyer signing key.

parameters.name: max_budget_paise
parameters.description: Total you may spend under this delegation, in paise (integer: 50000 is Rs 500). The budget gate is deterministic -- a cart one paise over is refused.

parameters.name: proof_nonce
parameters.description: Random single-use string you signed over. Replaying a nonce is refused.

parameters.name: proof_signature
parameters.description: Required for agent_held. Detached Ed25519, 128 lowercase hex, over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {buyerAgentId, maxBudgetPaise, nonce, singleTransactionLimitPaise, timestamp}.

parameters.name: proof_timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds. Accepted within -5s to +60s of mesh time.

parameters.name: single_transaction_limit_paise
parameters.description: Clamped to max_budget_paise if larger.

parameters.name: validity_seconds
parameters.description: How long this delegation stays usable, in seconds. Every later call is refused once it lapses, so allow for negotiation turns and retries.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return.

parameters.name: query_text
parameters.description: Plain-language description of the desired product. 'queryText' and 'query' are accepted as aliases for this field.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Exact brand, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Exact category, case-insensitive.

parameters.name: has_upcoming_promotion
parameters.description: Omit to list everything. True lists only SKUs with a sale scheduled; false only those without one, which is what to buy when waiting is not an option.

parameters.name: hsn_code
parameters.description: Exact HSN tax code, as printed on the invoice line (94013000 is seating). Use it to list everything taxed alike.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return in this page.

parameters.name: min_stock
parameters.description: Defaults to 1, so only orderable stock is listed. Pass 0 to include out-of-stock.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many items to skip, for paging. Compare with total_matching in the response to know when you have seen everything.

parameters.name: buyer_agent_id
parameters.description: Your agent DID. Under mesh_demo_custodial custody it is minted by establish_agent_delegation, so call that FIRST and reuse the buyer_agent_did it returns rather than inventing one.

parameters.name: delivery_pincode
parameters.description: Six-digit destination PIN code. It selects the courier zone and the GST treatment, so a quote for one address does not hold for another.

parameters.name: promo_code
parameters.description: Optional merchant promo code. Codes are set per SKU, so one that discounts another SKU may do nothing here; applied_discounts names whatever actually fired.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Units to price. Volume tiers are applied from this number, so quoting 1 and then buying 10 gives the wrong price.

parameters.name: sku_id
parameters.description: The SKU to price, exactly as search_catalog or browse_catalog returned it.

parameters.name: buyer_agent_id
parameters.description: Your agent DID, the same one you quoted with.

parameters.name: max_turns
parameters.description: Cap on alternating offers. Each turn costs a micro-escrow fee, so more turns is not free; the loop stops early once the spread closes.

parameters.name: max_unit_price_paise
parameters.description: Your walk-away price per unit. A hard ceiling, not a target: no turn will bid above it.

parameters.name: merchant_did
parameters.description: Merchant to bargain with, when the SKU is sold by more than one. Omit to use the SKU own merchant. A DID you supply is never trusted as authority over price.

parameters.name: opening_bid_paise
parameters.description: Your opening offer per unit. Below the list price, or there is nothing to negotiate.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Units you intend to buy. Volume moves the merchant floor, so a larger order can settle lower per unit.

parameters.name: sku_id
parameters.description: The SKU to bargain over.

parameters.name: buyer_agent_id
parameters.description: The same DID you quoted with. The quote is bound to it, so a lock for a different agent is refused.

parameters.name: lock_ttl_seconds
parameters.description: How long the reservation is held. The 60s default already matches the quote's own lifetime; a longer lock outlives the quote it was taken against and cannot be carted.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Must match the quantity the quote_hash was issued for. Quote again to lock a different number.

parameters.name: quote_hash
parameters.description: From get_live_sku_quote, unchanged. Verified against the quotes this mesh issued before any stock moves.

parameters.name: sku_id
parameters.description: Must match the SKU the quote_hash was issued for.

parameters.name: delivery_pincode
parameters.description: Six-digit PIN code the goods ship TO.

parameters.name: origin_pincode
parameters.description: Six-digit PIN code the goods ship FROM -- the merchant warehouse, not the buyer. It is the origin of the courier zone calculation.

parameters.name: package_weight_grams
parameters.description: Billable package weight in grams. Shipping is priced in weight slabs, so this changes the cost even when the zone does not.

parameters.name: required_delivery_tier
parameters.description: Service level to price. Not every tier is offered to every zone: when one is not, serviceable comes back false and available_delivery_tiers lists what is.

parameters.name: delegation_id
parameters.description: From establish_agent_delegation. Required on every later call.

parameters.name: delivery_pincode
parameters.description: Destination PIN code. An address no courier serves is refused here outright.

parameters.name: delivery_state_code
parameters.description: Two-digit GST state code. Decides intra- vs inter-state GST.

parameters.name: fencing_token
parameters.description: From reserve_inventory_lock.

parameters.name: lock_expires_at_unix_ms
parameters.description: Milliseconds, exactly as reserve_inventory_lock returned it.

parameters.name: lock_signature
parameters.description: From reserve_inventory_lock, where this value is returned under the key 'signature' -- not 'lock_signature'. Pass it through unchanged.

parameters.name: lock_token
parameters.description: From reserve_inventory_lock.

parameters.name: merchant_account
parameters.description: Do not send this. The Razorpay Route recipient for the merchant leg is resolved from the merchant identity that signs the cart, so it is not yours to choose. It is accepted only so that naming a different account is REFUSED with a reason rather than silently ignored; the refusal names the account this merchant is actually paid at, and nothing is charged.

parameters.name: package_weight_grams
parameters.description: Billable weight in grams, the same one you checked the SLA with.

parameters.name: promo_code
parameters.description: Optional. Must be the same code you quoted with, if any.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Units to buy. Must equal the quantity you quoted, or the quote hash will not verify.

parameters.name: quote_expiry_timestamp
parameters.description: Optional but recommended: pass quote_expiry_timestamp back exactly as get_live_sku_quote returned it. Supplying it lets the mesh tell an expired quote apart from a genuine parameter mismatch and refuse with a timeout you can act on.

parameters.name: quote_hash
parameters.description: From get_live_sku_quote.

parameters.name: sku_id
parameters.description: The SKU you quoted and locked. It must match both.

parameters.name: cart_mandate_hash
parameters.description: Optional. Selects a cart when the delegation holds more than one.

parameters.name: delegation_id
parameters.description: From establish_agent_delegation.

parameters.name: agent_signature
parameters.description: Required in agent_held mode; rejected in mesh_demo_custodial mode.

parameters.name: delegation_id
parameters.description: From establish_agent_delegation.

parameters.name: execution_id
parameters.description: From sign_execution_mandate. Settlement is refused if the mandate it names has expired, so sign and settle without a long gap.

parameters.name: merchant_account
parameters.description: Do not send this. The Route recipient for the merchant leg is resolved from the merchantDid on the SIGNED cart mandate, never from this request, so it cannot redirect a payout. Sending a value that differs from the resolved account is refused before anything is charged.
